scope: Grammar questions 36–58: Mondai 1 (13 items), star ordering (5 items), and passage cloze (5 items).

questionPdf.method: Read the connected Google Drive PDF text and visually inspected printed pages 4–6 in Chrome at 75% and 100%. Compared all four M1 choices, the five ★ placements, the complete cloze passage, and its choices with the app data.

answerReference.name: Sohu question-by-question answer review
answerReference.qualification: Secondary answer reference, not an official JLPT marking sheet. Its M1 sequence agrees with the key stored in the app.

mondai1.result: Compared PDF wording and answer choices; checked each choice rationale against the sentence context. Corrected question 10 (app question 45), where the source prints そのまま but the app had dropped the final ま.

starOrdering.result: The five printed ★ slots were visually checked on page 5. Each reconstructed order places the stored answer at the printed third blank and forms a grammatical sentence. The extracted text layer appends page number 6 to question 18 option 4; the visual PDF shows the option is only 車の運転が, so the app text is correct. Added completed-fragment scripts, choice-by-choice ordering explanations, and the source PDF to provenance.

cloze.result: Compared the app passage and choices with the full printed page 6. Added a contextual reason for each correct choice, why each alternative does not fit, and a Vietnamese translation for every blank's sentence context.

sectionDataRepairs: Grammar-reading section question 42 had ruby text 客きゃく inserted into the prompt and trailing full stops on choices 1, 3, and 4; removed those artifacts to match the PDF.
Grammar-reading section question 57 choice 2 had an extra が after そんな部屋; corrected the choice to そんな部屋.
Repaired furigana import artifacts in the karaoke passage: 大おお勢ぜい to 大勢 and 自じ由ゆう to 自由.
